Ellicott Small Animal Hospital of Buffalo, NY believes that the relationship between you, your pet, and your veterinarian should be one of communication, compassion, and care. We encourage you visit our website, www.ellicottvets.com,  to learn about Our Mission & Vision. Explore our site further to see what veterinary services we have to offer. We look forward to meeting you and your pet!

Our Mission
Helping make pets a healthier part of Western New York families by recommending and providing excellent veterinary medical care that is communicated compassionately and effectively.
